Title: Returns a non-empty array of numeric booking ids
Expected Result: Status 200. The body is a non-empty array and every item has a numeric bookingid.

Title: Filter by firstname and lastname finds the new booking
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Expected Result: Status 200 and the list contains the new booking id.

Title: Filter by lastname only finds exactly the new booking
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Expected Result: The list is exactly the new booking id.

Title: Filter by a checkin date before the booking checkin returns the booking
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20

Title: Filter by a checkin date after the booking checkin does not return the booking
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20
Expected Result: The list does not contain the booking.

Title: Filter by the same checkin date returns the booking (>= rule)
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20
Expected Result: The list contains the booking (greater than or equal). Known defect D-01: the live API returns an empty list.

Title: Filter by the same checkout date returns the booking
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20

Title: Filter by a checkout date before the booking checkout returns the booking (>= rule)
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20
Expected Result: The list contains the booking (greater than or equal). Known defect D-02: the live API filters with "<=" and returns an empty list.

Title: Filter by a checkout date after the booking checkout does not return the booking (>= rule)
Preconditions: A booking with checkin 2031-05-10 and checkout 2031-05-20
Expected Result: The list does not contain the booking. Known defect D-02: the live API returns it.
